query: The Time, Effort, or Expense Required to Create the Work
response: According to the given context, when examining a work for original authorship, the U.S. Copyright Office will focus solely on the appearance or sound of the work that has been submitted for registration. The time, effort, or expense required to create the work are not considered in determining whether it satisfies the originality requirement. These factors have no bearing on whether a work possesses the minimum creative spark required by the Copyright Act and the Constitution.
